$comment: §4.1/§4.2 — the alliance semantics: never-shoot, wards, preferences, hold-fire. Emitted alone by overlay-class plays; folded across active overlays in ladder order (union of bans and wards, preferences concatenated then deduplicated keeping first occurrence, hold_fire disjunction, §7.1). Caps are roster sizes, so any fold fits by construction.
title: combat_policy

prefer.$comment: ORDERED list, priority order, duplicates rejected by name; at most the four distinct tags; omit when empty. Deterministic semantics: §5.2.

hold_fire.$comment: omit when false; do not initiate — return fire at identified aggressors inside the 120-tick window only (§5.2)

teams.$comment: SET: sorted, deduplicated team names; ≤ 16; omit when empty

seats.$comment: SET: sorted, deduplicated SeatOrDuoRef strings (seat:N, duo:<team>); ≤ 32; omit when empty; duo: refs valid only in mode br (noDuosInMode)
